result.description: A fictional ultra-wide desktop display designed for immersive simulation dashboards, audio-visual editing, and split-view productivity. The Nimbus 49 features a curved 32:9 OLED panel with 5120 x 1440 resolution, 240Hz refresh rate, adaptive sync support, and factory-calibrated color output for studio work. Connectivity includes USB-C with laptop charging, DisplayPort, HDMI 2.1, and a built-in KVM switch for two-system workflows. The stand offers height, tilt, and swivel adjustments, while the rear shell uses a matte graphite finish with subtle ambient lighting.
